meal.title: Create a Symbol Count Dictionary for the Slot Machine
meal.objective: Build a dictionary that maps each slot symbol to the number of times it appears on a reel

voice.script: What if the machine could count its own symbols? How do we track how many of each symbol appear on a reel? A dictionary stores pairs of keys and values, so we can use the symbol as the key and its count as the value. First we list the symbols that appear on a single reel. Then we loop over those symbols, count how often each shows up, and store the result in a dictionary called symbol_counts. Finally we print the dictionary so you can see the mapping. That’s all you need to know about creating a symbol count dictionary.
